description: Saved public biological question and planner proposal with disease context incorrectly placed in an edge endpoint property; runtime and private audit metadata omitted.
question: Which genes at the chr17 MAPT/PLEKHM1 locus (43–46 Mb) are differentially expressed in alpha cells in T1D?

proposal.interpreted_question: Which genes located on chromosome 17 between 43 and 46 Mb (the region containing MAPT and PLEKHM1) show differential expression in alpha cells in type 1 diabetes?

steps.question: Identify all genes on chromosome 17 with genomic coordinates overlapping 43,000,000-46,000,000 bp (GRCh38.p14)
Which of these chr17 43-46Mb genes are recorded as differentially expressed (T1D DEG) in alpha cells in type 1 diabetes?

candidate_queries:
MATCH (a:Gene)-[deg:T1D_DEG_IN]->(b:anatomical_structure)
WHERE a.chr = "17"
  AND a.genome_assembly = "GRCh38.p14"
  AND a.start_loc <= 46000000
  AND a.end_loc >= 43000000
  AND b.id = "CL_0000171"
  AND a.id IN $dep_0
WITH a, deg, b
ORDER BY a.id, deg.adjusted_p_value, elementId(deg)
WITH collect(DISTINCT a) + collect(DISTINCT b) AS nodes,
     collect(DISTINCT deg) AS edges
RETURN nodes, edges;

MATCH (a:Gene)-[deg:T1D_DEG_IN]->(b:anatomical_structure)
WHERE a.chr = "17"
  AND a.genome_assembly = "GRCh38.p14"
  AND a.start_loc <= 46000000
  AND a.end_loc >= 43000000
  AND b.id = "CL_0000171"
  AND deg.end_id = "MONDO_0005147"
  AND a.id IN $dep_0
WITH a, deg, b
ORDER BY a.id, deg.start_id
WITH collect(DISTINCT a) + collect(DISTINCT b) AS nodes,
     collect(DISTINCT deg) AS edges
RETURN nodes, edges;
